Hello! I am a Sophomore at Truman State University in Kirksville, MO. I'm currently pursuing a double major in Statistics and Environmental Science with a minor in Math. My current goals are to develop skills in math, statistics, and data science, and couple that with broader subject matter knowledge in environmental science, which intersects sustainability, ecology, earth science, and public health. I don't yet have a specific career to aim for after graduation, but I am interested in exploring research.

In the past year, I've had the opportunity to attend many departmental seminars/colloquia in agriculture, biology, and mathematics, and several university-wide student research symposia. I've gotten some experience in data analysis, fieldwork/experimental design, basic lab techniques, and math research/presentation preparation through group and individual projects in coursework. These experiences have made me confident in wanting more experience, and I'm searching for external REU programs for the coming summer that explore the intersections of math and ecology.
